jobs.title: Runtime Engineer
jobs.description:
Runtime Engineer

📍 Stockholm or Helsingborg, Sweden

We’re looking for someone who likes solving problems that happen in the real world.

Our POS platform is used by thousands of merchants every day.

When something goes wrong, it matters.

A slow system matters.

A failed deployment matters.

A service that goes down matters.

We’re looking for someone who is  technically curious, driven and interested in understanding how systems behave in production.

You don’t need to know everything.
You don’t need to be an expert in every cloud technology.
But you should enjoy solving problems, asking questions and taking ownership.

What you’ll do

Build and improve the runtime environment for our services
Work with Azure, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure
Improve monitoring, logging, alerting and observability
Make deployments safer and easier
Investigate incidents and find ways to prevent them from happening again
Automate repetitive operational work
Work closely with Software Engineers to improve reliability and performance
Use AI tools to investigate, troubleshoot, automate and improve systems

What we’re looking for

A strong technical mindset and the ability to solve problems with technology
Good understanding of systems, infrastructure and how software behaves in production
Strong problem-solving skills and engineering judgement
Curiosity about why systems fail and how to make them better
Ability to learn quickly and work independently
Interest in making AI a fundamental part of how you work
Drive, ownership and willingness to learn
Fluent in both Swedish and English

Experience with  Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, observability or distributed systems
 is valuable.

Experience with  AKS, RabbitMQ or .NET
 is a plus.

You don’t need to know everything. We care more about how you think and learn than about matching every technology on the list.

🤖 Our view on AI

AI is becoming a fundamental part of how we engineer and operate systems.

Use it to explore systems, investigate incidents, analyse logs, automate tasks and work faster.

But don’t blindly trust it.

You are responsible for understanding what is happening, challenging assumptions and making sure the solution is right.

AI gives you leverage.

Engineering judgement keeps production running.

🏪 Why join us?

Our POS platform is used by  thousands of businesses across the Nordics every day
.
The problems are real. Reliability matters. Performance matters. Recovery matters.

If you enjoy understanding why systems fail — and figuring out how to make sure they don’t fail again —  we’d love to hear from you.

Come help us build a POS platform that businesses can rely on.

About Confirma Software Confirma Software is a fast-growing Nordic technology group focused on innovation and long-term value creation.
Today, we consist of  29 software companies
 across multiple verticals, including POS, ERP, Payroll, Access Control and more. We continue to grow through acquisitions.

This is an opportunity to combine the  stability of a strong Nordic software group
 with the energy of building a  next-generation platform
.

 Welcome with your application!

Contact,
Karsten Ahlberg

Enginering Manager POS
E-post: karsten.ahlberg@crona.se

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med modern teknik i ett växande bolag som driver samhällsviktiga projekt? Är du en erfaren utvecklare som brinner för Rust, molnteknik och innovation? Nu söker vi en Software Developer med fokus på Rust
som vill vara med och utveckla nästa generations lösningar i ett spännande och högteknologiskt projekt.

Om rollen
Som Software Developer
blir du en del av ett mindre, korsfunktionellt utvecklingsteam som arbetar med att designa, utveckla och drifta moderna systemlösningar från idé till produktion. Teamet arbetar agilt med kontinuerliga leveranser och stort fokus på kvalitet, automation och samarbete.

Du kommer att samarbeta nära verksamheten och andra tekniska team för att säkerställa att lösningarna uppfyller både affärsbehov och högt ställda krav på säkerhet, prestanda och regelefterlevnad.
Arbetet sker huvudsakligen på distans med möjlighet att arbeta från någon av verksamhetens kontorshubbar runt om i landet. Teamet träffas fysiskt några gånger per år för gemensamma teamdagar och planering.

Arbetsuppgifter
Utveckla moderna applikationer med fokus på Rust
Designa och implementera skalbara lösningar i molnmiljöer
Säkerställa integrations- och gränssnittsdesign mellan olika system
Utveckla automatiserade tester och bidra till QA-processer
Paketera, dokumentera och implementera tekniska leveranser
Arbeta med containeriserade lösningar och Kubernetes-plattformar
Bidra till FinOps-arbete och optimering av molnresurser
Arbeta i regulatoriskt styrda miljöer med höga krav på säkerhet och compliance

Vi söker dig som har
4–8 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling
Erfarenhet av utveckling i Rust
Erfarenhet av Azure, AWS eller GCP
Erfarenhet av containers och Kubernetes
Erfarenhet av applikationsutveckling i moderna plattformsmiljöer
Erfarenhet från verksamheter med höga krav på säkerhet, kvalitet och efterlevnad
God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

Meriterande erfarenheter
WebAssembly
WebAssembly Component Model
Foreign Function Interfaces (FFI)
Linux och C-ABI
Kryptografi, SSL/TLS, SSH och digital signering
Open Source/FOSS
Golang
Java
C# eller C++

Uppdragsorter:
Stockholm/Malmö/Linköping

Vem är du?
Du är en nyfiken, engagerad och lösningsorienterad utvecklare som trivs med att arbeta i team. Du gillar att lära dig nya tekniker och delar gärna med dig av dina kunskaper till kollegor.
Vi tror att du uppskattar att arbeta nära verksamheten, tar ansvar för helheten och drivs av att skapa långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.

Vi erbjuder
Ett långsiktigt uppdrag med stor samhällsnytta
Möjlighet att arbeta med modern teknik i framkant
Flexibelt arbetssätt med hög grad av distansarbete
Kompetenta och engagerade kollegor
Möjlighet att påverka arkitektur, teknikval och arbetssätt
Kompetensutveckling och kontinuerligt kunskapsutbyte

Säkerhetsprövning
Tjänsten omfattas av säkerhetsskyddslagstiftning, vilket innebär att säkerhetsprövning genomförs innan anställning eller uppdrag påbörjas.

Välkommen med din ansökan och bli en del av ett team som utvecklar framtidens säkra och hållbara digitala lösningar.

jobs.title: Kafka Engineer
jobs.description:
emagine is looking for a Kafka Engineer

As a Kafka platform Engineer within ICC, you are responsible for building, operating, and continuously improving integration and platform capabilities that are used by multiple development teams.

The role focuses on integration of platform stability, automation, self-service, and end-to-end operational responsibility (you build it – you run it). This position is centered around Apache Kafka cluster & Hive MQ administration and the automation of related management tasks, ensuring reliable operation and scalability of the platforms. While the position is not focused on daily application development, you are expected to participate in customer projects when needed.

Info:

2026-10-19 - 2027-09-30

Start: ASAP

Location: Stockholm (hybrid)

Language: English

Responsibilities

Design, deploy, and maintain multi-cluster, multi-region Apache Kafka environments managed by the Strimzi Operator or similar on Kubernetes, as well as enterprise HiveMQ MQTT brokers.
Drive the platform upgrade lifecycle (minor and major versions) for Kafka, Strimzi, and HiveMQ, coordinating platform patching cadences seamlessly to mitigate CVEs with zero application downtime.
Develop and maintain custom Kafka Connectors (Source/Sink) for seamless data movement between legacy systems and the cloud.
Formulate and implement scaling strategies, node affinity rules, topology spread constraints, and persistent volume management optimized for IOPS-intensive message workloads.
Manage Kafka broker partition layouts, topic compaction configurations, segment retention behaviors, and cluster-wide resource allocation.
Design high-availability and disaster recovery strategies, including cross-region replication and automated failover, to maintain platform resilience as usage scales.
Enforce data governance standards through the management of Schema Registries (Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema).
Architect edge traffic routing to messaging clusters using advanced ingress layers, translating complex routing policies and managing edge capabilities like Envoy Gateway or custom proxies.
Enforce data governance boundaries by implementing Kafka ACLs, SASL authentication structures, and integrating API Managers for authentication intercept handles (e.g., managing OAuth/OIDC validation paths).
Implement robust end-to-end security frameworks, including mutual TLS (mTLS) validation, SSL verification, SASL/SCRAM and RBAC for the platforms.
Build and maintain deep observability pipelines using Prometheus and Grafana, configuring custom dashboards to monitor critical broker KPIs.
Formulate proactive alerting rules to catch cluster anomalies, such as KubeNodeNotReady, JVM memory degradation, disk capacity thresholds, or storage detached states, before they impact production workloads.
Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for platform outages and implement automated guardrails to prevent recurrence.
Provide Tier 3 support for complex integration issues, such as consumer lag, rebalance loops, or network bottlenecks.
Act as a technical subject matter expert (SME) for application engineering teams developing in Java / Spring Boot, advising on optimal Producer/Consumer settings (e.g., acks, idempotency, batch sizing, schema management).
Ensure stability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Architect and maintain reusable GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines to validate, lint, and test infrastructure manifests, Kafka client configurations, and custom plug-ins prior to deployment.
Utilize automated scaling frameworks like KEDA (Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling) to dynamically scale application consumers based on real-time lag and throughput metrics.
Treat infrastructure strictly as code by leveraging Helm for packaging, resource templating, and managing OCI artifacts.
Provide clean abstractions, developer self-service tooling, and documented READMEs to empower development teams to provision topics, schemas, and credentials safely within architectural guardrails.
Handle incident, problem, and change management at platform level.
Work with Security, Architecture, and development teams.

Required Competence

Platform & Cloud

4–6 years of experience with Apache Kafka, Strimzi, Kafka Connect API, Kraft.
4–6 years of experience working with Java and Spring Boot Framework
Experience with PostgreSQL
Strong experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
Linux experience (including WSL)
GitHub Actions and ArgoCD
Knowledge of Splunk, Fluent Bit and Helm

DevOps & Automation

CI/CD using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or equivalent)

Observability

Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus
Fluent Bit or OpenTelemetry

Streaming & Messaging

Apache Kafka at platform level (clusters, performance, security)
HiveMQ broker

Nice to Have

Experience in APIM platforms
Experience in Azure, AWS or Google cloud
Cloud cost optimization experience
Experience of working at an Integration department in large enterprise environments

Personal Attributes

Strong problem-solving skills
Humble attitude
Comfortable with operational responsibility
Fluent in English (Swedish is an advantage)

jobs.title: Backend Developer, Partner Integrations
jobs.description:
Are you a backend developer who enjoys building reliable integrations and delivering scalable solutions? Are you motivated by taking ownership of your projects from development to deployment?

Then you could be the one we are looking for to help build the integrations that connect JACK & JONES, VERO MODA and ONLY with leading marketplaces such as Amazon and Zalando! We offer the opportunity to work in a quality-driven environment with plenty of opportunities for professional development and technical challenges.

THE DEPARTMENT

Brand Tech is a dynamic e-commerce department with the ambition of making our brands the preferred fashion choice across both our own webshops and external marketplaces. You will join an in-house team of experienced frontend and backend developers working closely together to deliver robust digital solutions across brands.

You will become part of an international environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are central to the way we work.

THE JOB

As part of the Partner Team, you will develop and maintain the backend connectors that integrate our brands with marketplaces such as Amazon, Zalando and other partners. Your focus will be on building reliable, scalable integrations that ensure accurate and efficient data exchange.

Working in a data-driven environment, you will help ensure that product information, stock levels and pricing flow seamlessly between our internal systems and external marketplace platforms.

Your responsibilities will include:

Developing and maintaining APIs and marketplace connectors
Ensuring stable synchronisation of product data, stock and pricing
Onboarding new marketplace partners
Optimising integrations and data flows across systems
Taking ownership of projects from implementation to deployment.

YOUR PROFILE

You're motivated by solving technical challenges and enjoy building reliable, scalable solutions. You're curious by nature, enjoy learning new technologies and value collaboration and knowledge sharing. You like working closely with your teammates and seeing your work through from development to deployment.

We care more about your curiosity, technical skills and genuine interest in software development than ticking every box. What matters most is that you:

Have experience with .NET / C#
Have experience working with XML and JSON
Communicate well and enjoy collaborating across teams
Speak and write English fluently

Experience with one or more of the following is an advantage:

Marketplace or e-commerce APIs (e.g. Amazon SP-API, Zalando Partner Program (zDirect), Tradebyte or Channable)

Kubernetes
Jira, GitHub and GitHub Actions
Unit and integration testing
Google Cloud Platform or other cloud providers
Datadog
Microservice architecture
Event-driven integrations and message queues (e.g. Google Pub/Sub or Amazon SQS).

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU

I
f you have any questions regarding the position, feel free to contact Rasmus Skjoldborg Jørgensen +45 82 38 21 56. Otherwise, please send your application and CV along with relevant examples of your skills and previous projects no later than 30 October 2026.

WORKPLACE:
Brande Denmark.

About Bestseller

At BESTSELLER, we are more than 20,000 people in 38 different countries working for over 20 fashion brands such as JACK & JONES, SELECTED, VERO MODA, ONLY, PIECES, VILA, OBJECT, MAMALICIOUS, NAME IT, NOISY MAY and Y.A.S. We are a family-owned company with a strong foundation and values to build on, empowering us to pursue the ideas we believe in to take BESTSELLER forward. We are committed to diversity and provide equal opportunities for everyone, irrespective of sex, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We strive to create an empowering environment where people can thrive and develop. For more information, visit www.bestseller.com.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build and maintain the services that support our product operations. You will own backend features and production issues across management platforms, configuration, integrations, and operational workflows. This role requires strong .NET engineering skills, sound technical judgement, and a focus on reliability under high traffic.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs supporting product operations and internal management platforms.
Build reliable workflows for configuration, operational controls, data processing, and platform integrations.
Own technical design and delivery for complex features, including code reviews, testing, documentation, and production rollout.
Improve service performance, database queries, concurrency handling, and availability.
Investigate production incidents, identify root causes, and implement lasting fixes.
Leverage Vibe Coding practices and AI coding tools to boost individual and team productivity, and explore AI-driven innovations in development workflows.
Work with product, frontend, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver and support backend features.
Mentor junior engineers and help improve engineering standards and system maintainability.

Required Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
At least 5 years of hands-on backend development experience, including ownership of production services.
Strong practical experience with C# and .NET Core / .NET.
Solid understanding of RESTful API design, HTTP, service integrations, and backend system design.
Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server), including SQL optimization; familiarity with NoSQL databases is an advantage.
Ability to write clean, maintainable, thread-safe code and design for data consistency, scalability, and fault tolerance.
Experience diagnosing performance issues and resolving incidents in live systems.
Clear communication skills and the ability to make technical decisions while working across teams.

Vibe Coding & AI-Assisted Development

Practical Vibe Coding experience, proficient in using AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude) to complete development tasks efficiently.
Skilled in Prompt Engineering to guide AI in generating high-quality code, with the ability to effectively review and refine AI-generated output.
Familiar with AI-assisted development workflows, integrating AI tools into coding, debugging, testing, and documentation phases to boost productivity.
Strong judgment on the quality of AI-generated code, understanding its limitations and ensuring code security and maintainability.

Preferred Skills

Experience with high-traffic digital platforms or operational systems.
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, distributed systems, and monitoring tools.
Experience building internal tools, configuration systems, or integrations with external platforms.
CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar).
Experience scaling Vibe Coding / AI tool adoption to the team level.
Open-source contributions or active technical blog writing.
